title: Grit: The power of passion and perseverance
speaker: Angela Lee Duckworth

sentences.en: Transcriber: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast When I was 27 years old,
sentences.zh: 笔录:约瑟夫·吉尼评论:莫顿·巴斯特 当我27岁时

sentences.en: I left a very demanding job in management consulting for a job that was even more demanding: teaching.
sentences.zh: 我留下了一个非常苛刻的工作 在管理咨询 一个甚至更苛刻的工作: 教学。

sentences.en: I went to teach seventh graders math in the New York City public schools.
sentences.zh: 我去纽约市公立学校教七年级学生数学

sentences.en: And like any teacher, I made quizzes and tests.
sentences.zh: 和任何老师一样 我做了测验和测验

sentences.en: I gave out homework assignments. When the work came back, I calculated grades.
sentences.zh: 我完成了作业 工作回来的时候 我算了分数

sentences.en: What struck me was that IQ was not the only difference between my best and my worst students.
sentences.zh: 最让我吃惊的是 智商并不是我最好的学生 和我最坏的学生的唯一区别

sentences.en: Some of my strongest performers did not have stratospheric IQ scores.
sentences.zh: 我的一些最强的表演者没有平流层智商分数。

sentences.en: Some of my smartest kids weren't doing so well.
sentences.zh: 我的一些最聪明的孩子 做的不好。

sentences.en: And that got me thinking. The kinds of things you need to learn in seventh grade math, sure, they're hard: ratios, decimals, the area of a parallelogram.
sentences.zh: 这使我思考。在七年级数学中你需要学习的东西, 当然,它们很难:比率,小数, 平行图的区域。

sentences.en: But these concepts are not impossible, and I was firmly convinced that every one of my students could learn the material if they worked hard and long enough.
sentences.zh: 但是,这些概念并非不可能,我坚信,我的学生只要努力工作,工作时间足够长,他们都可以学习这些材料。

sentences.en: After several more years of teaching, I came to the conclusion that what we need in education is a much better understanding of students and learning from a motivational perspective,
sentences.zh: 经过几年的教学,我得出结论, 在教育方面,我们需要的是 更好地了解学生 从激励的角度学习,

sentences.en: from a psychological perspective. In education, the one thing we know how to measure best is IQ.
sentences.zh: 从心理角度来说 在教育方面 我们最擅长的就是智商

sentences.en: But what if doing well in school and in life depends on much more than your ability to learn quickly and easily?
sentences.zh: 但是,如果在学校和生活中做得很好,那又会如何? 这要取决于你迅速和容易地学习的能力。

sentences.en: So I left the classroom, and I went to graduate school to become a psychologist.
sentences.zh: 于是我离开了教室 上了研究生院 成为一名心理学家

sentences.en: I started studying kids and adults in all kinds of super challenging settings, and in every study my question was, who is successful here and why?
sentences.zh: 我开始在各种极具挑战性的环境中 学习孩子和成人, 在每个研究中,我的问题是,谁在这里成功,为什么?

sentences.en: My research team and I went to West Point Military Academy.
sentences.zh: 我和我的研究小组去了西点军事学院

sentences.en: We tried to predict which cadets would stay in military training and which would drop out.
sentences.zh: 我们试图预测哪些学员将留在军事训练中,哪些将辍学。

sentences.en: We went to the National Spelling Bee and tried to predict which children would advance farthest in competition.
sentences.zh: 我们去了国家拼写蜜蜂 并试图预测哪些儿童 在竞争中进步最远。

sentences.en: We studied rookie teachers working in really tough neighborhoods, asking which teachers are still going to be here in teaching by the end of the school year, and of those, who will be the most effective
sentences.zh: 我们研究新手教师 在非常艰苦的街区工作, 问哪些教师 仍然会在这里 教学到学年结束时, 和那些, 谁将是最有效的

sentences.en: at improving learning outcomes for their students?
sentences.zh: 提高学生的学习成绩?

sentences.en: We partnered with private companies, asking, which of these salespeople is going to keep their jobs?
sentences.zh: 我们和私人公司合作,问, 这些销售人员中谁会保留他们的工作?

sentences.en: And who's going to earn the most money? In all those very different contexts, one characteristic emerged as a significant predictor of success.
sentences.zh: 谁能赚到最多的钱呢?在所有这些非常不同的环境下,一个特征成为成功的重要预测者。

sentences.en: And it wasn't social intelligence. It wasn't good looks, physical health, and it wasn't IQ.
sentences.zh: 这不是社会智慧,不是外观,身体健康,也不是智商。

sentences.en: It was grit. Grit is passion and perseverance for very long-term goals.
sentences.zh: 格瑞特是追求长期目标的激情和毅力

sentences.en: Grit is having stamina. Grit is sticking with your future, day in, day out, not just for the week, not just for the month, but for years, and working really hard to make that future a reality.
sentences.zh: 格瑞特坚持你的未来 日复一日 不只是这个星期 不仅仅是这个月 而且是很多年

sentences.en: Grit is living life like it's a marathon, not a sprint.
sentences.zh: 格瑞特的生活就像马拉松 而不是短跑

sentences.en: A few years ago, I started studying grit in the Chicago public schools.
sentences.zh: 几年前,我开始在芝加哥公立学校学习功课。

sentences.en: I asked thousands of high school juniors to take grit questionnaires, and then waited around more than a year to see who would graduate.
sentences.zh: 我要求成千上万的高中生 接受质询, 然后等待 一年多左右 看谁将毕业。

sentences.en: Turns out that grittier kids were significantly more likely to graduate, even when I matched them on every characteristic I could measure, things like family income, standardized achievement test scores,
sentences.zh: 结果发现 最强壮的孩子 更可能毕业, 即使当我和他们匹配 每一个特点我可以衡量,

sentences.en: even how safe kids felt when they were at school.
sentences.zh: 甚至孩子们在学校的时候 感觉有多安全

sentences.en: So it's not just at West Point or the National Spelling Bee that grit matters.
sentences.zh: 所以不只是在西点或者国家拼写蜜蜂 才是最重要的

sentences.en: It's also in school, especially for kids at risk for dropping out.
sentences.zh: 学校里也是 特别是有辍学风险的孩子

sentences.en: To me, the most shocking thing about grit is how little we know, how little science knows, about building it.
sentences.zh: 对我来说,最令人震惊的事情 坚果是我们知道的很少, 科学知道的很少, 建造它。

sentences.en: Every day, parents and teachers ask me, "How do I build grit in kids?
sentences.zh: 每天,父母和老师都问我, “我怎样才能在孩子身上建立起勇气呢?

sentences.en: What do I do to teach kids a solid work ethic?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么教孩子 扎实的工作道德?

sentences.en: How do I keep them motivated for the long run?"
sentences.zh: 我怎样才能让他们有长期的动机?"

sentences.en: The honest answer is, I don't know. (Laughter) What I do know is that talent doesn't make you gritty.
sentences.zh: 诚实的回答是,我不知道。 (笑声)我所知道的是,才华不会让你变得很迷人。

sentences.en: Our data show very clearly that there are many talented individuals who simply do not follow through on their commitments.
sentences.zh: 我们的数据非常清楚地显示,有许多有才华的个人根本不履行其承诺。

sentences.en: In fact, in our data, grit is usually unrelated or even inversely related to measures of talent.
sentences.zh: 事实上,在我们的数据中,优势通常与人才的量度无关,甚至反之亦然。

sentences.en: So far, the best idea I've heard about building grit in kids is something called "growth mindset."
sentences.zh: 到目前为止,我听过的最好的想法 建设坚果在孩子身上 是一个叫"成长心态"的东西。

sentences.en: This is an idea developed at Stanford University by Carol Dweck, and it is the belief that the ability to learn is not fixed, that it can change with your effort.
sentences.zh: 这是由卡罗尔·德威克在斯坦福大学开发的理念, 相信学习能力不是固定的, 它会随你的努力而改变。

sentences.en: Dr. Dweck has shown that when kids read and learn about the brain and how it changes and grows in response to challenge, they're much more likely to persevere when they fail,
sentences.zh: Dweck博士已经证明,当孩子们阅读和学习 大脑以及它如何变化和成长 来应对挑战, 他们更有可能坚持 当他们失败,

sentences.en: because they don't believe that failure is a permanent condition.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不相信失败是永久性的

sentences.en: So growth mindset is a great idea for building grit.
sentences.zh: 因此,增长的心态 是一个伟大的想法 建设坚果。

sentences.en: But we need more. And that's where I'm going to end my remarks, because that's where we are.
sentences.zh: 但是我们需要更多。这就是我要结束我的发言, 因为我们就在那里。

sentences.en: That's the work that stands before us. We need to take our best ideas, our strongest intuitions, and we need to test them.
sentences.zh: 这是摆在我们面前的工作。我们需要采取我们最好的想法, 最强烈的直觉, 我们需要测试它们。

sentences.en: We need to measure whether we've been successful, and we have to be willing to fail, to be wrong, to start over again with lessons learned.
sentences.zh: 我们需要衡量我们是否成功, 并且我们必须愿意失败, 错误地, 重新开始 吸取教训。

sentences.en: In other words, we need to be gritty about getting our kids grittier.
sentences.zh: 换句话说,我们得小心翼翼地让孩子变得坚强些。

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢。 （掌声）
